hits.snippet: # SECURITYWEEK NETWORK: ## Week of July 27, 2026 **Nozomi Networks** has appointed co-founder **Andrea Carcano** as Chief Executive Officer (CEO), resuming the role he held when the company launched. Carcano, who served as Nozomi’s CPO for the past decade, resumes the CEO role from Edgard Capdevielle, who transitions to executive advisor. Nozomi Networks was [acquired by Mitsubishi Electric](https://www.securityweek.com/mitsubishi-electric-to-acquire-nozomi-networks-for-nearly-1-billion/) for $1 billion.
